scope: Current IX–X source-built traditional, visual and formal companion inputs. Inactive variants, exact source excerpts, generated catalogues, code, evidence and scientific figure assets excluded from changes.
coverage_method: Every inventoried candidate paragraph read in context. A separate second reading of changed contexts, with adjacent mathematical statements consulted for ambiguous scope. Candidate counts are source occurrences, not unique editorial issues. Ranges, eponyms and technical terms deliberately retained.
retained_exceptions: Logical hypothesis and open-question lists, source locator headings, declaration/source-module catalogues and bibliographic records retain necessary semicolon separators. All double-dash/en-dash candidates are eponyms, ranges, or technical paired terms. Necessary mathematical compounds remain, including p-adic, prime-power, finite-dimensional, mixed-step, inverse-limit, characteristic-zero and address/rank designations. Scope-defining contrastive phrasing remains when it distinguishes a proved claim from a stronger unproved claim.

standalone_single_hyphen_check.reason: Both are TeX column-width arithmetic in continuation_11.tex.
